short: Domain-Size-Dependent Residual Stress Governs the Phase-Tran
title: Domain-Size-Dependent Residual Stress Governs the Phase-Transition and Photoluminescence Behavior of Methylammonium Lead Iodide

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Reports disagree on whether MAPbI3 shows a low-temperature orthorhombic-tetragonal transition and dual PL emission. Domain size, through the residual stress it stores, should govern the phase transition and PL behaviour of MAPbI3.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/gap), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/variable_sweep), n5 (DES/route), n6 (PRC/synthesis), n15 (PRC/treatment), n17 (PRC/stimulus). Premises: Prior PL studies disagree: nanocrystals show no transition to 3 K, PC dual emission at 15 K, large SC one orthorhombic peak with an abrupt 150 K transition

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Domain size spans four decades: ~0.1 um (PC), ~10-100 um (HOC) and ~1e2-1e3 um (SC). All three states are the same MAPbI3 phase of the same composition; their as-grown pattern differences are preferred orientation only.
states.detail: Absorbed: n7 (STR/microstructure/feature_size), n8 (STR/phase/identity), n9 (STR/phase/lattice), n10 (STR/phase/lattice), n12 (STR/phase/fraction). Premises: Williamson-Hall: size broadening is temperature independent, so the temperature-dependent part of the linewidth is inhomogeneous strain; PL near 750 nm is the orthorhombic phase of MAPbI3 and PL near 780 nm the tetragonal phase

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: The 2.0% unit-cell volume change stores residual stress between the two phases; the stress grows with domain size and resists transformation. As-grown emission below 150 K ranks with crystalline state: PC dual peak plus IR tail, HOC intermediate, SC a single peak.
states.detail: Absorbed: n11 (MEC/pathway), n13 (PRP/value), n14 (PRP/value), n16 (PRP/value), n21 (PRP/value). Premises: The unit-cell volume changes by 2.0% across the orthorhombic-tetragonal transition of MAPbI3; PL near 750 nm is the orthorhombic phase of MAPbI3 and PL near 780 nm the tetragonal phase

states.title: Performance state
states.head: Power-dependent PL acts as a gauge of the crystallinity of SC perovskite

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Domain-size-dependent residual stress governs the orthorhombic-tetragonal transition and the PL of MAPbI3

nodes.title: SEM, F1
nodes.head: Inset domain-size histograms peak near 0.1 um (PC), 10-100 um (HOC) and 1e2-1e3 um (SC) on top-view SEM at 0.5, 100 and 5 um scale bars
nodes.solves: Domain size spans four decades: ~0.1 um (PC), ~10-100 um (HOC) and ~1e2-1e3 um (SC)
nodes.note: sizes taken off the log D_L axis of the inset histograms and cross-checked against the scale bars; the SEM fields show ~100-300 nm grains (PC), ~10 um-wide stripes (HOC) and a featureless SC face; the histograms are small and single-barred, so the reading is coarse; linked text gives <200 nm, ~70 um, >1000 um
nodes.necessity_reason: No member reaches image_support shown and n7 has no other figure-backed support.

nodes.title: DIFF, F1
nodes.head: Ground powders of all three states reproduce the full theoretical MAPbI3 reflection set, while as-grown SC and HOC show only a peak near 40.5 deg
nodes.solves: All three states are the same MAPbI3 phase of the same composition; their as-grown pattern differences are preferred orientation only
nodes.note: as-grown (F1b): SC one strong 40.5 deg peak plus a weak 20 deg, HOC one strong 40.5 deg, PC 14.1/28.4/31.8/40.5 deg; after grinding (F1c) all four traces coincide with the green theoretical trace; trace colours are labelled only in F1b
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n8 (o2).

nodes.title: evidence, F2
nodes.head: 2theta of (004)/(400) and (242)/(224) falls with temperature smoothly for SC but with curvature and offsets for PC and HOC
nodes.solves: Lattice expansion with temperature is near-linear in SC but non-linear in PC and HOC, in both phases
nodes.note: plane indices (004), (242), (400), (224) are written beside the curves; SC (blue) sits near 42.28 and 41.02 deg below 150 K, PC (red) near 42.5 and 41.45 deg; all traces run 100-270 K
nodes.detail: o4: 2theta of (004)/(400) and (242)/(224) falls with temperature smoothly for SC but with curvature and offsets for PC and HOC

nodes.title: PHYS:surfacearea, F2, F3, F4
nodes.head: Every trace steps down near 150 K; for PC (004) the two branches coexist over a shaded band from ~150 to ~175 K. Between 138 and 150 K the ~785 nm band grows against the ~745 nm band, earliest and strongest under the 325 nm laser, latest under 633 nm.
nodes.solves: The orthorhombic-to-tetragonal transition of SC starts at the domain surface and moves inward, finishing within <10 K
nodes.op: compare across conditions, inspect local feature, read characteristic point
nodes.note: the regime labels 'orthorhombic' and 'tetragonal(224)' are written along the bottom axis of F2a; the coexistence band is highlighted in yellow '325 nm Laser', '473 nm Laser', '633 nm Laser' are written above the three contour maps; under 325 nm the 785 nm band is already strong at 138 K, under 633 nm only a weak feature appears after ~147 K the depths delta = 493.7 / 60.6 / 19.6 nm and the isotherm names X-X', Y-Y', Z-Z' are written on the panel; at 148 K the 19.6 nm trace is dominated by the ~800 nm peak while the 493.7 nm trace still peaks at ~745 nm the gap is in the bottom (SC) TDPL panel of F3a only; the HOC panel is continuous across the same window
nodes.detail: o5: Every trace steps down near 150 K; for PC (004) the two branches coexist over a shaded band from ~150 to ~175 K; o7: Between 138 and 150 K the ~785 nm band grows against the ~745 nm band, earliest and strongest under the 325 nm laser, latest under 633 nm; o8: At 138, 143 and 148 K the ~785 nm share of the spectrum rises as the probe depth falls from 493.7 to 60.6 to 19.6 nm; a1: The SC TDPL map carries a blank horizontal band with no data from ~150 to ~165 K, exactly where the abrupt SC transition is claimed
nodes.inner_audit: a1: the gap is in the bottom (SC) TDPL panel of F3a only; the HOC panel is continuous across the same window

nodes.title: evidence, F2
nodes.head: Relative peak width drops from ~100% to ~50% at 150 K for SC, but peaks at ~260% (PC, 242) and ~128% (HOC) around 150-155 K
nodes.solves: Inhomogeneous residual lattice strain builds up toward the transition and its size depends on the crystalline state
nodes.note: three stacked panels labelled SC, PC, HOC; y axis reads Delta-sigma/sigma (%) with no normalisation temperature written on the panel
nodes.detail: o6: Relative peak width drops from ~100% to ~50% at 150 K for SC, but peaks at ~260% (PC, 242) and ~128% (HOC) around 150-155 K

nodes.title: evidence, F3
nodes.head: As grown: PC shows two emission branches plus an IR tail below 150 K and across 50-370 uW at 80 K; HOC is intermediate; SC shows one band
nodes.solves: As-grown emission below 150 K ranks with crystalline state: PC dual peak plus IR tail, HOC intermediate, SC a single peak
nodes.note: TDPL (left) and PDPL (right) sub-panels of the same crop, labelled PC, HOC, SC and '@ 80 K'; SC band sits at ~745 nm below 150 K and ~780 nm above; the PC PDPL map is normalised differently (blue-green background)
nodes.detail: o9: As grown: PC shows two emission branches plus an IR tail below 150 K and across 50-370 uW at 80 K; HOC is intermediate; SC shows one band

nodes.title: evidence, F3
nodes.head: After grinding, the second emission band and the IR tail are gone from all three: one band shifts from ~765 nm at 120 K to ~800 nm at 300 K
nodes.solves: After grinding all three converge on one tetragonal-like emission band that red-shifts smoothly, with no detectable transition below 150 K
nodes.note: 'After grinding' written on the panel; PDPL sub-panels show one band near 785-800 nm at every fluence for PC, HOC and SC; no discontinuity anywhere in the TDPL maps
nodes.detail: o11: After grinding, the second emission band and the IR tail are gone from all three: one band shifts from ~765 nm at 120 K to ~800 nm at 300 K
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n16 (o11).

nodes.title: PL, F5
nodes.head: PL at 80 K: one ~790 nm band for D_d of 20-50 nm, two bands (~750 and ~785 nm) for 50-200 um, one ~750 nm band above 300 um. Emission-regime map: single orthorhombic at low T and large domains, single tetragonal at high T, a dual band between that widens toward small domains.
nodes.solves: Transition temperature rises and the transition window narrows as domain size grows
nodes.op: compare across conditions, read characteristic point, replot derived series
nodes.note: nine stacked spectra labelled D_d < 20 nm to > 500 um with an arrow 'Domain size decrease'; D_d = 1 and 10 um are single broad asymmetric bands, D_d = 300 and 400 um a sharp 750 nm peak with a weak shoulder smoothed drawn summary with no data points or contour values; temperature axis runs downward from ~90 K to ~190 K; the dual/tetragonal boundary sits near 150-157 K at 5e2 um and the tetragonal field reaches ~105-110 K near zero domain size linked text says dual emission runs from 1 to 300 um and a single orthorhombic peak appears only above 500 um; D_d = 1 and 10 um also look single and broad rather than dual
nodes.detail: o12: PL at 80 K: one ~790 nm band for D_d of 20-50 nm, two bands (~750 and ~785 nm) for 50-200 um, one ~750 nm band above 300 um; o13: Emission-regime map: single orthorhombic at low T and large domains, single tetragonal at high T, a dual band between that widens toward small domains; a3: In F5a the 300 and 400 um spectra are already single orthorhombic peaks, so dual emission ends between 200 and 300 um, not above 500 um
nodes.inner_audit: a3: linked text says dual emission runs from 1 to 300 um and a single orthorhombic peak appears only above 500 um; D_d = 1 and 10 um also look single and broad rather than dual
nodes.necessity_reason: Changes support for S2: o13 partial; a3 contradicts

nodes.title: evidence, F6
nodes.head: PDPL of one SC at 80 K: a second band near 780-800 nm is absent after 1 day, faint after 1 month and strong after 3 months, strongest at low fluence. In the split 3-month crystal the shell shows two bands (~750 and ~785 nm) at 50-120 uW while the core shows one ~750 nm band at every fluence
nodes.solves: Atmospheric ageing turns the SC surface into a PC-like dual emitter while the core stays single-peak
nodes.note: F6 offers no crops, so the whole figure was read; the two bands are labelled P_O and P_T and the exposures '1 day', '1 month', '3 month' on the image; the 3-month P_T weakens above ~30 uW F6 offers no crops, so the whole figure was read; sub-panels labelled 'i Shell' and 'ii Core', spectra at 50, 120, 240 and 370 uW, '@ 77 K' written on both; the shell dual peak fades at 240 and 370 uW
